verdict.rationale: The evidence pack only discusses scoping and auditing AI agent board access (e.g., monday-docs-10, monday-docs-6) and general integration/security certifications, but contains no evidence of human-facing granular roles/permissions (viewer/editor/guest, board-level access control) that a product manager would assign to team members. Missing for full credit: documentation of user role types, board/item permission settings, or admin controls for human collaborators.
